_readme: Every rule and cap this repository applies. Set a rule to false to switch it off. `bans` replaces the defaults rather than adding to them.

_rules.file-header: Every file opens with a `// ====` header (rule 1)
_rules.property-jsdoc: Every property has JSDoc, of one sentence (rule 3)
_rules.header-cap: A file header is capped and has no subsections (rule 5)
_rules.jsdoc-cap: JSDoc prose is capped and its tags do not wrap (rule 6)
_rules.logic-comment-length: A logic comment is one line (rule 7)
_rules.no-history: No narrating what the code used to do (rule 9)
_rules.no-conversation: No referencing the conversation that wrote it (rule 10)
_rules.no-justification: State what is true, do not argue for it (rule 12)
_rules.comment-length: One sentence, under the character cap (rule 13)
_rules.todo-form: A marker carries an issue id (rule 16)
_rules.section-banner: No section banners in a small file (rule 18)

bans.name: no-history
bans.label: history
bans.pattern: \b(previously|used to|no longer|now that|was originally|is now|has been (renamed|moved|replaced|removed))\b

bans.name: no-conversation
bans.label: conversation
bans.pattern: \b(as requested|per the plan|as discussed|this wave|we decided|phase \d)\b

bans.name: no-justification
bans.label: justification or consequence
bans.pattern: \b(so that|rather than|which is what|the reason|deliberately|on purpose|prevents|defaults to|falls back)\b
